description: Deploy and infrastructure reliability fixes (scripts and CFN only; nothing is run or deployed). Adds a CFN-driven .env generator, makes the evaluator CFN stack deploy reliably, makes the Module 3 user-creation loop Bash-3.2 compatible with a configurable demo password, and makes the EC2 sync git update deterministic. Independent of the app features (FEAT-001/FEAT-002) — can land in any order relative to them.
steps: Create deploy/generate-env.sh: query the same CFN stacks Home.py/agentcore_utils list (mladas-agentcore-memory, mladas-agentcore-evaluator, mladas-agentcore-gateway, mladas-agentcore-policy, mladas-agentcore-guardrail, m3-demo-cognito, m3-demo-verified-permissions) in ${AWS_REGION:-ap-southeast-1} via aws cloudformation describe-stacks, and write repo-root .env (the file sync-ec2.sh copies) with keys: AWS_REGION, SharedMemoryId, ToolSelectionEvaluatorId, GatewayId, PolicyStoreId, PolicyEngineId, GuardrailId, GuardrailVersion, UserPoolId/CognitoUserPoolId, UserPoolClientId/CognitoClientId, and the fixed CUSTOMERS_TABLE=m3-demo-customers and ORDERS_TABLE=m3-demo-orders. Only emit a key when its value resolved (never write blank/stale overwrites). Idempotent / safe to re-run (regenerate cleanly). Do NOT hardcode any resource id. set -euo pipefail; must pass bash -n. Do NOT run it.

In demos/infra-agentcore/cfn-agentcore-evaluator.yaml remove the resource OnlineEvalConfig (AWS::BedrockAgentCore::OnlineEvaluationConfig) and the now-unused EvaluationLogGroup and EvaluationExecutionRole (they exist only to support OnlineEvalConfig), and remove the OnlineEvalConfigId and OnlineEvalConfigArn outputs. Keep ToolSelectionEvaluator and ComplianceEvaluator plus their ...EvaluatorId / ...EvaluatorArn outputs intact (the app only needs ToolSelectionEvaluatorId / ComplianceEvaluatorId).

In demos/module3-security/scripts/deploy.sh replace 'declare -A USERS' + 'for EMAIL in "${!USERS[@]}"' with a Bash-3.2-safe loop: a newline-delimited list of 'email,role,dept,hero_name,max_refund' rows iterated with 'while IFS="," read -r EMAIL ROLE DEPT HERO MAX_REFUND; do ... done <<EOF ... EOF' (or a printf | while read pipe). Preserve all 5 hero users exactly: clark.kent@dailyplanet.com=admin/finance/Superman/10000, bruce.wayne@waynetech.com=security_lead/security/Batman/5000, peter.parker@bugle.com=agent/support/Spider-Man/500, diana.prince@themyscira.gov=manager/operations/Wonder Woman/2000, tony.stark@starkindustries.com=engineer/engineering/Iron Man/0. Preserve the admin-create-user custom attributes (custom:role, custom:department, custom:hero_name, custom:max_refund) and the admin-set-user-password --permanent step.

In demos/module3-security/scripts/deploy.sh change DEFAULT_PASSWORD="Hero\$ecure1!" to DEFAULT_PASSWORD="${DEMO_USER_PASSWORD:-Hero\$ecure1!}" so the live default is unchanged but can be overridden via the DEMO_USER_PASSWORD env var. Never commit a new secret.

In deploy/sync-ec2.sh replace the remote 'git pull origin main' command with 'git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main' (run as the ubuntu user, same cd $REPO_DIR), keeping the .env copy step and the service restart intact.

Update deploy/README.md: document deploy/generate-env.sh usage; document the DEMO_USER_PASSWORD override for module3 deploy.sh; document the opt-in zero-downtime option (raise ASG mladas-app-asg MaxSize to 2 before an instance refresh) without changing default live behavior.
acceptance_criteria: `bash -n deploy/generate-env.sh`, `bash -n deploy/sync-ec2.sh`, and `bash -n demos/module3-security/scripts/deploy.sh` all pass under local Bash 3.2.
`grep -c 'declare -A' demos/module3-security/scripts/deploy.sh` returns 0; all 5 hero names still present.
`grep -n 'DEMO_USER_PASSWORD' demos/module3-security/scripts/deploy.sh deploy/README.md` shows both the default and the doc note.
`grep -n 'reset --hard origin/main' deploy/sync-ec2.sh` matches; `grep -c 'git pull origin main' deploy/sync-ec2.sh` returns 0.

`grep -n 'CUSTOMERS_TABLE=m3-demo-customers' deploy/generate-env.sh` and `grep -n 'generate-env' deploy/README.md` and `grep -n 'MaxSize' deploy/README.md` all match. No resource ids hardcoded in generate-env.sh.
verification: bash -n deploy/generate-env.sh && bash -n deploy/sync-ec2.sh && bash -n demos/module3-security/scripts/deploy.sh && echo 'bash syntax ok'
findings: All steps implemented in the working tree; nothing run against AWS, nothing deployed/committed. deploy/generate-env.sh created (set -euo pipefail, chmod +x): queries the 7 app stacks via describe-stacks in ${AWS_REGION:-ap-southeast-1}, emits a key only when the output resolved (skips empty/None), writes atomically via mktemp+mv (idempotent). Output-key mapping verified against Home.py/agentcore_utils and the templates: SharedMemoryId (mladas-agentcore-memory), ToolSelectionEvaluatorId (mladas-agentcore-evaluator), GatewayId (mladas-agentcore-gateway), PolicyEngineId (mladas-agentcore-policy), GuardrailId/GuardrailVersion (mladas-agentcore-guardrail), PolicyStoreId (m3-demo-verified-permissions), UserPoolId/UserPoolClientId (m3-demo-cognito, emitted under both the UserPool* and Cognito* aliases the app accepts). CUSTOMERS_TABLE/ORDERS_TABLE written as fixed literals (not resolved ids). No resource ids hardcoded. cfn-agentcore-evaluator.yaml: removed OnlineEvalConfig + EvaluationLogGroup + EvaluationExecutionRole and the OnlineEvalConfigId/OnlineEvalConfigArn outputs; kept ToolSelectionEvaluator & ComplianceEvaluator plus their Id/Arn outputs. module3 deploy.sh: replaced declare -A/${!USERS[@]} with a while IFS=',' read -r ... done <<'EOF' loop preserving all 5 hero users, custom attrs, and admin-set-user-password --permanent; DEFAULT_PASSWORD now ${DEMO_USER_PASSWORD:-Hero$ecure1!} (default unchanged, no new secret). sync-ec2.sh: git pull -> 'git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main' (still sudo -u ubuntu, same REPO_DIR); .env copy + restart untouched. deploy/README.md: added generate-env.sh table row + usage, DEMO_USER_PASSWORD override, and opt-in zero-downtime note (raise mladas-app-asg MaxSize to 2 + instance refresh). Verification: all three bash -n pass under local Bash 3.2; declare -A count 0; OnlineEval count 0; ToolSelectionEvaluatorId & ComplianceEvaluatorId present; reset --hard matches and git-pull count 0; DEMO_USER_PASSWORD in script+README; CUSTOMERS_TABLE literal + generate-env/MaxSize in README; 5 hero names present. Note: README previously named the ASG mladas-demo-asg in prose, but sync-ec2.sh and the FEAT-003 spec use mladas-app-asg, so the new zero-downtime note uses mladas-app-asg (the real ASG).
